people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
translations.bsb: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and every creature on the earth.”
translations.kjv: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
translations.asv: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
